name: subhan-skills
description: Personal agent skills, installable on any machine

plugins.name: ship-issue
plugins.description: Take one GitHub issue or adhoc task to a finished PR: confirm criteria and a planning tier, plan in token-sized chunks (splitting the issue past two chunks), implement each chunk in a fresh Codex session, one review round, a usage ledger per run — the human merges.

plugins.name: plan-explainer
plugins.description: Build and publish a self-contained HTML explainer page — UI mocks from real design tokens, decision forks as selectable cards, a Copy-answers button — for plan approval and visual questions.

plugins.name: ui-evidence
plugins.description: Capture and publish screenshots or video that prove a UI change — accurate shell and commit, permanent URLs for the PR body, with an un-capturable convention so shots never quietly go missing.

plugins.name: codex-review
plugins.description: Drive one Codex review round on a GitHub PR — request, wait until actually settled, read the head commit's findings, and track resolution markers across rounds.

plugins.name: pr-media-upload
plugins.description: Upload a screenshot, GIF or screen recording to a public S3 bucket and get a permanent URL to embed in a GitHub PR description, issue or comment.

plugins.name: update-skills
plugins.description: Update every subhan-skills plugin to the latest marketplace version in both Claude Code and Codex, via each CLI's native plugin commands.
